meta.title: vela — land connected.
meta.description: Travel eSIM data plans for India and the Gulf. Buy before you fly, land connected, top up anytime.
meta.destinationDescription: Prepaid {{name}} eSIM data plans with instant QR delivery. Keep your number for calls.

hero.title: land connected.
hero.body: Travel data plans you buy before you fly. Your eSIM switches on the moment you land. No SIM swap, no roaming bill.
hero.noResults: Nothing found. Try a country or a region.

steps.title: Pick your destination
steps.body: Country, regional and global plans, from a week to a month.

steps.title: Install in one tap
steps.body: Scan the QR, or tap Install on iPhone. It takes about a minute.

steps.title: Land connected
steps.body: Data starts when you connect at your destination. Top up from the app.

home.appBody: Watch your data, top up in one tap and get a nudge before you run low.
home.appSoon: App links go live at launch.

destination.dataOnly: Data only · keep your number for calls and WhatsApp
destination.compatibleBody: iPhone XS and newer, Pixel 3 and newer, Galaxy S20 and newer. Your phone must be carrier unlocked.

faq.a: When your phone first connects to a network at your destination. Buying early doesn't use up days.

faq.q: Can I keep WhatsApp and my number?
faq.a: Yes. Your main SIM stays on for calls and SMS. vela only handles data.
Top up from the vela app in one tap. No new QR, no reinstall.

checkout.title: checkout
checkout.email: Email for your receipt and QR
checkout.failed: Payment didn't go through. You haven't been charged.
checkout.demo: Demo checkout. No card is charged. Try GULF20 or FIRSTSAIL.
checkout.notFound: This plan isn't available any more.

success.title: you're connected.
success.qrHint: Scan with the phone you're travelling with. Each code installs once.
success.installHint: On iPhone with iOS 17.4 or later, open this page on the phone and tap Install.
iphoneSteps: Choose Use QR Code and scan the code above
Name the line vela and use it for Cellular Data
Turn on Data Roaming for the vela line when you land
androidSteps: Tap Add eSIM, then scan the code above
Set vela as the mobile data SIM
Turn on Roaming for the vela SIM when you land
success.missingBody: Open the link from your receipt email, or find your eSIM in your account.

account.title: your account.
account.signInBody: We'll email you a sign-in link. Demo: any email works.
account.emptyBody: Pick a destination and you'll be connected the moment you land.
account.topUpInApp: Top up in the vela app
account.error: We couldn't load your eSIMs. Try again.

footer.prices: Prices in INR and include GST.
